overview: Germany is a country in Central Europe and the most populous member of the European Union. Its capital and largest city is Berlin. After the Second World War, Germany was divided into West and East Germany; the Berlin Wall fell in 1989 and the country reunited in 1990. Germany is a federal republic of 16 states and has one of the largest economies in the world.

geography.text: Germany's landscape rises from north to south. The north is a flat plain facing the North Sea and the Baltic Sea. The centre has wooded hills and low mountains, and in the far south the Alps rise along the border with Austria, where the Zugspitze is the country's highest peak. Its great rivers include the Rhine, the Elbe and the Danube.
